EC1: - History of clinically significant medical conditions including: Cardiovascular: Atrial Fibrillation, [OR] Ventricular Fibrillation, Significant Coronary Artery Disease. Hepatic: Viral [OR] or Autoimmune Hepatitis, [OR] Cirrhosis of the Liver, [OR] Liver Metabolism Disorders. Renal: Any form of renal impairment. EXPAREL® is cleared by the kidneys, thus any form of renal impairment could lead to an adverse reaction.
EC2: - Medical condition(s) [OR] or concurrent surgery that may have required analgesic treatment in the postoperative period for pain that was [NOT] not strictly related to the study surgery.
EC3: - Any clinically significant event [OR] or condition discovered during surgery that may have complicated the patient's post surgical course such as vascular [OR] or nerve involvement that was unknown before surgery.
EC4: - History of allergic reactions attributed to compounds of similar chemical or biologic composition to liposomal bupivacaine.
EC5: - Pregnant women are [NOT] excluded from this study because EXPAREL has the potential for teratogenic [OR] or abortifacient effects. Because there is an unknown but potential risk for adverse events in nursing infants secondary to treatment of the mother with EXPAREL, [OR] breastfeeding should be [NOT] discontinued if the mother is treated with EXPAREL.
